name: Light Lunch
title: Keep lunch moderate on days that need a sharp afternoon.
benefit: A sharp afternoon instead of a slump.
subtitle: Meal Size
rationale: A large midday meal amplifies the natural afternoon alertness dip, and a moderate one does not.

evidence.summary: The post-lunch performance dip is well documented and scales with meal size; the exact size threshold is individual.

indications: Large lunches reliably precede a lost hour.
The day's key block sits at 2 to 4 p.m.
